candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on tokens related to fascism, Nazism, and associated hate speech or racial prejudice.
This feature vector activates on prefixes and roots related to governance, politics, economics, and academic disciplines.
This vector activates on common German definite articles, prepositions, and copula verbs.
This feature vector represents adjectives and modifiers that describe societal, interpersonal, or systemic domains.
This feature activates for traditional German masculine given names and historical honorifics.
This vector activates for German language terms, locations, and cultural entities.
This feature vector activates strongly on common word suffixes and root fragments ending in the letters "av".
This vector is related to adverbial suffixes, particularly the Spanish and Italian equivalents of "-ly" and noun-forming suffixes containing "-ment".
This feature vector represents common Portuguese nominal and adjectival suffixes and inflectional endings.
This feature activates for terms, roots, and fragments associated with existence, externality, and historical destruction.
